note: Code derivation: data/guatemala_2024_homes.do (rename *, lower at line 29; rename block lines 91-96; Bookmark #7: Roads / highways, lines 512-552) lowercases every column and renames P04A07A1..A4, P04A07B to r_p04a07a1..r_p04a07a4, r_p04a07b (prefix-only, number-preserving rename; exempt from Step 5b). The INE data dictionary (ENCASBA.2024_Diccionarios.xlsx, sheet Hogares, positions 84-88) labels each column, 5/5, and the codes are the questionnaire's own printed numbering (P04A07A rows 1-4; P04A07B). Step 3b: live items (5, resp 1-10) match the questionnaire's interurban roads block ('carreteras y caminos que llegan a este lugar') exactly, distinct from the streets/avenues block P04A06 (guatemala_2024_homes_avenues); no instrument mismatch. Words are the official Spanish questionnaire p.4 (checked against the rendered page image at 200 dpi), not the dictionary labels; they agree character-for-character on 4/5 items, the exception being P04A07A1, dictionary '¿Se encuentran en un buen estado, libres de agujeros y deslaves, etc?' vs questionnaire '¿Se encuentran en buen estado, libres de agujeros, deslaves, etc?' (questionnaire shipped, including its 'etc?' without a period, as printed). Printed line breaks (A4, B stem, left framing) joined with a single space; wide gaps in the justified B stem on the page image ('nada  satisfecho(a)', 'totalmente  satisfecho(a)') are typesetting, and the PDF text layer and the dictionary label both have single spaces, as shipped. Structure (mirrors batch_627 guatemala_2024_homes_avenues): the P04A07 left-hand framing 'Con relación a las carreteras y caminos que comunican a este lugar con otros lugares poblados' (no final punctuation, as printed) applies to the whole block -> instructions; the P04A07A lead-in 'De acuerdo con su experiencia, las carreteras y caminos que llegan a este lugar:' is shared by A1-A4 -> section_prompt of section _1; P04A07B -> section _2, no prompt. This block has no screener question. Interviewer lines 'Lea las opciones.' / 'Espere la respuesta.' not shipped. Options as printed: A1-A4 SÍ 1 / NO 2 / NS 3 (dictionary value labels identical); the do-file recodes only 98, so resp 3 NS (don't know) is kept on A1-A4 (nominal yes/no/don't-know, not ordinal). P04A07B prints bare 1-10 bubbles plus 98 'NO SABE / NO RESPONDE' (dictionary value labels = own number; 98 labelled 'No sabe / No responde'); option_text for resp 1 and 10 carries the endpoint anchors defined in the stem, 2-9 left blank; code 98 set missing by the do-file without dropping rows. Item content note: A4 (bribe request) is negatively worded, so SÍ is the unfavourable answer there. No skip pattern: every one of the 6,886 Hogares rows is non-blank on all five columns in the source xlsx. Route 9 (server-side GROUP BY on the live table, no export) against ENCASBA.2024_Hogares.xlsx value counts: 22/22 valid item x resp cells equal (a1 1/2/3 = 2465/4123/298; a2 3821/2752/313; a3 2873/3686/327; a4 157/6530/199; b 1..10 = 698/303/335/401/1240/541/648/901/365/964) and the single NULL cell equals the source code-98 count (b 490 NULL live = 490 code 98 in source); a1-a4 have 0 NULL in both. Live: 34,430 rows (= 5 x 6,886), 6,886 ids, 34,430 distinct id-item, 490 NULL resp (1.4%).
